snippet.title: THE BURROW MASSACRE - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You have been kidnapped by a maniac who has taken you to his lair... Can you survive the night and escape "The Burrow"?

THE BURROW MASSACRE Is a retro style slasher horror game with PS1 inspired graphics. 

Music by RXTTEN

Coming soon to Itch.io
